name: Good Wood Nashville
old_description: Since 2012, we’ve built a reputation for offering unique materials that bring warmth and authenticity to every space.
about:
Good Wood Nashville was founded in 2012 in Nashville, Tennessee, as a locally owned lumber store. The company began with a focus on supplying unique, character-rich wood materials to the Middle Tennessee region.

Operating from a 15,000-square-foot warehouse located 1.5 miles from downtown Nashville, the company stocks a curated selection of premium dimensional lumber, hardwood flooring, live-edge slabs, mantels, beam wraps, reclaimed barnwood, and plywood. It also distributes Festool brand tools and offers turn-key installation on select projects. Materials are shipped nationwide across the United States.

The supplier serves a mix of homeowners, custom home builders, interior designers, contractors, architects, and woodworkers. Its materials have been used in new construction, historic renovations, and commercial fit-outs throughout Nashville and beyond.

Good Wood Nashville emphasizes American-sourced, tariff-free lumber, highlighting a curated inventory chosen for quality, character, and timeless appeal. The company also carries Lunawood, a thermally modified Nordic pine and spruce product line from Finland, marketed for its durability and sustainability.
